title: Top Desk Lamps for Eye Comfort (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the sources that listed them, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one source. The Eufy Lumos A4 was highlighted by Lighting Design Alliance as the best LED lamp, while BenQ e-Reading, Honeywell Sunturalux, and Humanscale Nova were noted by Business Insider.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.
